item.title: Concern for possible emerging sink hole, 16th August
item.description:
I am a dog walker around the poverest area and often walk down Sward Road and up Oakdene Road. In the last 3 months, I have noticed that the paving slabs on Sward Road, as you approach Robin Hood green are lifting at at strange angle. Some of the gardens on oakdene road have developed some fairly deep trenches and the tree on the roundabout continues to sink.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Sward Road, Poverest, Greater London
